items.headline: Democrats Take Control of U.S. Congress in Historic Midterm Election Shift
items.summary: In the 2026 U.S. midterm elections, the Democratic Party secured majorities in both the House of Representatives and the Senate. This legislative shift creates a divided government in Washington for the remaining two years of President Donald Trump's term, directly influencing upcoming domestic policy decisions and international relations.

items.headline: NASA Seeks Commercial Help to Save the Hubble Space Telescope
items.summary: NASA has formally requested proposals from private space companies to boost the Hubble Space Telescope into a higher orbit and extend its scientific mission. The 35-year-old observatory is gradually losing altitude and risks re-entering Earth's atmosphere around 2033 without commercial servicing or an orbital boost.

items.headline: Netflix Acquires Joel Coen's Gothic Mystery 'Jack of Spades' Co-Written with Ethan Coen
items.summary: Netflix has secured global rights to Joel Coen's upcoming feature "Jack of Spades," a gothic mystery set in 1880s Scotland. The project is making entertainment headlines because it marks a writing reunion between brothers Joel and Ethan Coen and stars Patsy Ferran alongside Josh O'Connor.
